title: 第5章 有苦自己扛挨打自己受第6章 往往都是事情改变人人却改变不了事情
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
感受到压力的姜云天大脑飞速转动，灵光一闪，问道上“老毕登，系统有没有绝世功法，丹药，让我快速恢复，别人一穿越，可都是系统在手，天下我有，我们这系统应该也有吧，”
“想得美啊，我们都是这样想的，可是一顿操作猛如虎，最后发现自己是个二百五，系统发任务，我们接任务，任务完成后有奖励，最多有时有个暴击奖励，其它的都没有”
“啊？”
我特发，姜云天也是无语了
“有苦自己扛，挨打自己受，没有完成任务还要被抹杀，以为自己是天选之子，实际是我们更像是天选打工人”
听到此处，姜云天也是给干沉默了。
神念一转，这时恰巧青儿提着一个食盒进入房间，今天的食物不错，有肉有酒，但此时姜云天却脑袋中灵光一闪，我身体恢复了，这事还不能外传，姜云浩若是知道此事，会不会再下杀手，不要我还没有生娃，就杀身成仁了。
姜云天道“青儿，你这仙食是从哪里来的，是你自己做的吗？”
青儿柔声道“云天哥哥，是我做的，自从你中毒以后，家中的下人都被迫以各种理由离开了，现在偌大年院子，只有你我二人，如果不是昨日婆婆来，这所屋子本就是婆婆的，也没人会轻易来，这三年以来，就再没来过第三个人了。”
听到此话，姜云天道“以后你不可告诉任何人我的近况，吃食也还是按原来准备，对外采买，也要说洒食是你自己所用，切不可让人起疑啊。”
青儿大眼睛呼扇几下，嫣然一笑“嗯，都听云天哥哥的”
姜云天被青儿的大眼睛呼扇迷糊了。
但姜云天还是忍耐住了，他前世最看不上的就是一年四季像春天那般的人，没有一点君子风度，他是有风度的。
读过书的，作为一个打工标杆，这些他能忍耐。
却在此时，青儿递来一碗酒，轻声道“云天哥哥，你喝”
姜云天先是闻了一闻，这酒与在蓝星的味道有些像，但有一股子像是药酒的味，姜云天接过酒杯一饮而尽，酒杯放下，这是婶能忍，叔不能忍啊，姜云天二话不说，拉起青儿，青儿俏脸一红，又说道“云天哥哥，你先吃饭吧”
，姜云天却先拉住了青儿的手，青儿脸已红透。
半个时辰后，，青儿端着酒食，姜云天则是舒服地躺着，姜云天心里那个美呀。
姜云天看到窗口挂的小内内，想了想问道这“青儿，这几日青鸳婆婆来过吗？”
“云天哥哥，婆婆说有重要的事情要办，这两日应该就回来了，你有什么事吗？”

姜云天道“没有什么要紧的事，就是我现在毒伤有所缓解，我想看看在修行上有没有什么办法”
听到此处，青儿沉默了，随后嫣然一笑，“云天哥哥，你不要急，现在先恢复身体，修行的事，要从长计议。”
姜云天点了点头不再言语。
青儿看到他像是在思考问题，轻轻从他怀中移开，打扫战场，拎着食盒出门而去。
姜云天正在思考之际，忽然青儿神色慌张地跑来，对着姜云天叫道，“云天哥哥，姜云浩来了，你快躺下，快点。”
姜云天神色一冷，自然知道自己因何成为如此这般，钻入被中，并顺手将床边的帘幕拉下，想到这还不够，又急速运功，气血因毒素逆行，随即吐出一口黑血，脸色也是一白。
青儿刚到床边，看到姜云天吐血，也是一惊，大叫道“云天哥哥，你又吐血了，别吓我呀，云天哥哥。”
顿时嘤嘤怪附体，抽泣起来。
这时，只见一个与姜云天面容年纪相仿，身材无差的白衣青年，健步而来，身后前呼后拥，身旁依偎着一个美丽女子，但见这女子，手若柔荑，肤若凝脂，一身白衣，腰间一束绣着青莲的丝带，行走间，步步莲花，百媚千娇，姜云天看得一愣，心中一动。
旋即不动声色，闭目不动。
身边传来嘤嘤怪的哭声“云天哥哥，呜呜呜......”
姜云浩来到近前，也不说话，就在床前看着，一言不发，过了一会儿，身边的女子开口说话道“这个废物还挺能扛，都三年了，还吊着一口气不死，不如自己了断了好”
转过脸去看着姜云浩语调妩媚说道“浩哥哥，你看他，离死不远了，让他自生自灭吧，不然我们动手，又落人口舌。”
姜云浩点了点头，问道“青儿，你今天怎么备了仙酒仙食，是为他准备的吗？”
该来的还是来了，青儿止住哭泣道“云浩哥哥，我是给婆婆准备的，婆婆说要今日回来，我就准备了，不曾想她没有来。”
顿了一下，又继续说道“婆婆没有来，我就自己吃了，怕浪费了。”
姜云浩听到此处，松了一中气，他本以为听到暗线报告，说是青儿今天准备仙食，心中紧张，以为是姜云天好转了，现在看来，是为青鸳太上长老准备的，心下了然，看来是太紧张了，这废物怎么可能好，早晚就是个死，毒虽不重，却是几乎无解，除非龙影大陆修仙顶端的人物出来，方可有救，就连青鸳婆婆也是无能为力的。
想到此处，姜云浩换了一张笑脸，说道“青儿，云天大哥得你这三年来的悉心照看，想来死了无憾了。
content_en:
Feeling the pressure, Jiang Yuntian's brain was spinning rapidly, and with a flash of inspiration, he asked, "Old Bideng, does the system have any peerless skills or elixirs that can help me recover quickly? When others travel through time, the system is in hand. I have it in the world, and our system should also have it."
"It's a beautiful idea, we all think so, but after a quick operation, we find ourselves as a 250-year-old. The system issues tasks, and we take them. After completing the tasks, there are rewards. At most, there is a critical hit reward, but there is nothing else."
"Huh?"
I'm so sorry, Jiang Yuntian is also speechless.
"You have to bear the hardships on your own, you have to suffer when you are beaten. If you don't complete the task, you will be wiped out. We think that we are the chosen ones. In fact, we are more like the chosen workers."
Hearing this, Jiang Yuntian also fell silent.
With a sudden thought, Qing'er happened to enter the room with a food box. Today's food was good, including meat and wine. But at this moment, Jiang Yuntian had a flash of inspiration in his head. My body has recovered. This matter cannot be spread. If Jiang Yunhao knew about this, would he kill me again? Don't kill me before I have a baby.
Jiang Yuntian said, "Qing'er, where did your immortal food come from? Did you make it yourself?"
Qing'er said softly, "Brother Yuntian, I did it. Since you were poisoned, the servants in the family have been forced to leave for various reasons. Now there are only you and me in the big Nian yard. If my mother-in-law hadn't come yesterday, this house belongs to her, and no one would come easily. In the past three years, there has been no third person here."
Hearing this, Jiang Yuntian said, "In the future, you are not allowed to tell anyone about my current situation. When eating, you should prepare the food as before and buy it from outside. You should also say that the food is for your own use. Don't make people suspicious."
Qing'er opened her big eyes a few times and smiled sweetly, "Well, I listen to brother Yuntian."
Jiang Yuntian was confused by Qing'er's big eyes.
But Jiang Yuntian still endured it. What he looked down on the most in his previous life was people who were like spring all year round. They didn't have any gentlemanly demeanor, but he did have demeanor.
As someone who has studied and is a role model for part-time workers, he can endure these things.
But at this moment, Qing'er handed over a bowl of wine and said softly, "Brother Yuntian, drink it."
Jiang Yuntian smelled it first. The wine tasted somewhat similar to the one in Blue Star, but there was a hint of medicinal wine. Jiang Yuntian took the wine glass and drank it in one gulp. He put the glass down. This was what his aunt could bear, but his uncle couldn't. Without saying a word, Jiang Yuntian pulled Qing'er up. Qing'er blushed and said, "Brother Yuntian, you should eat first."
, but Jiang Yuntian took Qing'er's hand first, and Qing'er's face turned red.
Half an hour later, Qing'er was serving wine and food, while Jiang Yuntian was lying comfortably. Jiang Yuntian felt so beautiful.
Jiang Yuntian saw the small underwear hanging in the window, thought for a moment and asked, "Qing'er, has Grandma Qingyuan been here these days?"
"Brother Yuntian, my mother-in-law said she has important things to do. She should be back in the next two days. What can I do for you?"
Jiang Yuntian said, "It's nothing important. It's just that my poisonous injuries have been relieved now. I want to see if there is any way to practice."
Hearing this, Qing'er fell silent, and then smiled sweetly, "Brother Yuntian, don't be anxious, recover your body first, and consider the long-term plan for cultivation."
Jiang Yuntian nodded and said nothing.
Seeing that he seemed to be thinking about a problem, Qing'er gently moved away from his arms, cleaned the battlefield, picked up the food box and went out.
While Jiang Yuntian was thinking, Qing'er suddenly ran over in a panic and shouted to Jiang Yuntian, "Brother Yuntian, Jiang Yunhao is here, lie down quickly, hurry up."
Jiang Yuntian's expression turned cold. Naturally he knew why he was like this. He got into the quilt and pulled down the curtain beside the bed. Thinking that this was not enough, he quickly exercised his energy and blood due to the toxins. Then he spit out a mouthful of black blood and his face turned pale.
Qing'er just arrived at the bedside and saw Jiang Yuntian vomiting blood.He was also shocked and shouted, "Brother Yuntian, you are vomiting blood again. Don't scare me, brother Yuntian."
Suddenly, he was possessed by the moaning monster and started sobbing.
At this time, I saw a young man in white clothes with a face and age similar to Jiang Yuntian, with the same figure, walking towards him, and he was surrounded by a beautiful woman. However, when he saw this woman, her hands were as soft as catkins, and her skin was like gelatin, she was dressed in white, with a ribbon embroidered with green lotus around her waist. She was walking with lotus flowers, all charming and charming. Jiang Yuntian was stunned and his heart moved.
Immediately he became silent, closed his eyes and remained motionless.
A weird cry came from beside me, "Brother Yuntian, wuwuwu..."
Jiang Yunhao came closer and didn't say a word. He just looked at the bed without saying a word. After a while, the woman next to him spoke and said, "This piece of trash is quite capable. It's been three years and he's still hanging on. It's better to end it yourself."
Turning to look at Jiang Yunhao, he said in a charming voice, "Brother Hao, look at him, he is not far from death. Let him fend for himself, otherwise we will get angry again."
Jiang Yunhao nodded and asked, "Qing'er, why did you prepare immortal wine and immortal food today? Are you preparing it for him?"
What was supposed to come finally came. Qing'er stopped crying and said, "Brother Yunhao, I prepared it for my mother-in-law. My mother-in-law said she would come back today, so I prepared it. I never thought she didn't come."
After a pause, he continued, "My mother-in-law didn't come, so I ate it myself for fear of wasting it."
When Jiang Yunhao heard this, he breathed a sigh of relief. He thought he had heard a secret report that Qing'er was preparing immortal food today. He was nervous and thought it was Jiang Yuntian who was getting better. Now it seems that it was prepared for Supreme Elder Qingyuan. He felt relieved. It seemed that he was too nervous. How could this waste be cured? Sooner or later he would die. Although the poison was not serious, there was almost no cure. Unless the top figures in Longying Continent's cultivation came out, even Granny Qingyuan was helpless.
Thinking of this, Jiang Yunhao changed his smile and said, "Qing'er, Brother Yuntian needs your careful care for the past three years. I think he will die without regrets.
